reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific new intervention (5 at% V substitution into NbMoTaW) to improve room-temperature ductility by lowering the Peierls barrier, while maintaining high-temperature strength and irradiation resistance. No passage studies this alloy or this mechanism; it combines the known brittleness of NbMoTaW (P1, P17) with the general idea that V can alter dislocation behavior (P10, P12) and that lattice distortion aids irradiation resistance (P36, P40), but the specific prediction and integrated test are not found in the literature.
